decision_question: At the same padded 24-block budget, does forward-marginal dense-label search materially improve the singleton selector on the held-out Layer-14 hard cell, and does the selected payload survive BF16 coefficient round-trip?
leakage_policy: All three outcome-aware selectors read same-record dense AV and are explicitly non-deployable.
Forward marginal search re-evaluates the complete selected set after every candidate addition.
No selector, basis, predictor, or hyperparameter is fit for later reuse.
The captures are development-exposed; this gate diagnoses representation headroom only.
stop_rules: Do not train a router or implement a kernel unless BF16 forward-marginal quality passes both gates.
A forward-greedy failure is strong evidence but not a global combinatorial impossibility proof.
Do not claim deployability, attention speedup, rollout quality, or prompt generalization.
